title: Brown repeats the vacuum experiment at Bahnson's Institute of Field Physics
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Brown repeats the vacuum experiment at Bahnson's Institute of Field Physics, about 1950s at Institute of Field Physics, North Carolina, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
